items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Yeah, he played with me. He played bass.

ctx.x: Alright, same people. The same people. So alright. That's the same thing when we play the move on rules. See? Now we play the move on rules. Sometimes we play three or four nights a week. That, you see? For Spain. Well alright. Now you know I couldn't go there and keep playing that same number over and over. It was impossible to do that. So well, alright. Just like I said, a fella asked me, like you said, well you know such a number? You know what I mean? I don't have it. I don't have it. See? I don't have it.…
See me there? See me standing up here?

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: So Russ played with me, Andrew Morgan, all the other people.

ctx.x: Yeah. T. Rouch, or no, no, I mean not him. Bikes. And that boy would do Rodney, that boy plays. He was playing. Then I had with the chorus playing, you know, he play with Fat Domino now. He used to play guitar. He played bass with Fat Domino. Little short fella. Oh I know, Jimmy Davis. Yeah, Jim. From up to Carrollton. Yeah, little Jim. Little Jim played with us a long time. And then on his rope rope. He told me that you told me. Yeah, on his rope rope, playing with me there. You know what I mean? But I'll tell…
